6773.title: Persistent service retains a session-only executable
6773.rootCauseOneLine: The POSIX installer persists the shell's temporary Node lookup path in systemd ExecStart rather than the running executable's stable path.
6773.proposedFix: Capture process.execPath when selecting Node and retain an installer regression that executes the persisted path after deleting its shell symlink.
6773.caveats: Reproduced through the actual installer with isolated service/enrollment fixtures; no real WSL reboot, fnm session manager, or live systemd journal was tested.
